Through these programs, SpaceWERX awards contracts to drive the development of technologies with both military and commercial potential.</p>
</div><div class="brxe-block grid--auto-3-2 bricks-lazy-hidden"><div id="brxe-kfdbra" class="brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><h3 id="brxe-xubhwv" class="brxe-heading">What are the key differences?</h3><div id="brxe-uzmsfh" class="brxe-text"><ul>
<li><strong>Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR)</strong>: Established in 1982, SBIR funds research and development (R&D) conducted by <strong>small businesses</strong> (500 or fewer employees).</li>
<li><strong>Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR)</strong>: Established in 1992, STTR funds <strong>cooperative R&D projects</strong> between small businesses and <strong>non-profit U.S. research institutions</strong> (like universities).</li>
</ul>
<p>Both programs aim to transition promising commercial technologies into operational use for the U.S. Space Force, administered in partnership with the <a href="https://www.sbir.gov/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Small Business Administration</a>.</p>
</div></div><div id="brxe-oaltti" class="brxe-block gap--s bricks-lazy-hidden"><h3 id="brxe-tcbgiz" class="brxe-heading">The SpaceWERX Funding Process</h3><div id="brxe-qgfceb" class="brxe-block gap--xs bricks-lazy-hidden"><img src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E" class="brxe-image css-filter size-full bricks-lazy-hidden" alt="" id="brxe-eqepvh" decoding="async" data-src="https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/FundingPath-Web-Icon-1.svg" data-type="string" /><div id="brxe-yltcxe" class="brxe-text-basic">Find the Right Funding Path for Your Innovation at SpaceWERX.</div></div><div id="brxe-meawox" class="brxe-text"><p>SpaceWERX offers tailored SBIR/STTR funding opportunities to help small businesses and research institutions develop and transition innovative technologies for the U.S. Space Force.</p>
</div></div></div><div data-script-id="bdudmp" class="brxe-video"><iframe loading="lazy" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; fullscreen; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" title="SBIR STTR for Small Business Video" data-src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/fUChUAmpLaw?wmode=opaque&rel=0&enablejsapi=1&origin=https%3A%2F%2Fspacewerx.us&iv_load_policy=3" class="bricks-lazy-hidden"></iframe></div></div></section><section id="brxe-tcxgeu" class="brxe-section bricks-lazy-hidden"><div class="brxe-container bricks-lazy-hidden"><h3 id="brxe-vbydtq" class="brxe-heading">Funding Avenues by Phase of Development</h3><div id="brxe-xglzaf" class="brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><div class="brxe-gicnxg brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden" data-brx-loop-start="gicnxg"><h3 class="brxe-ypkrwz brxe-heading">Phase I: Feasibility Study</h3><div class="brxe-bhqonn brxe-text"><p style="text-align: center;">Prove the technical merit and commercial viability of your innovative idea. For Specific Topic efforts, this is a technical feasibility study. For Open Topic, it also includes a critical customer discovery phase.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>KEY DETAILS</strong>:<br />
<strong>Funding</strong>: $75K-$180K<br />
<strong>Duration</strong>: 3-12 months<br />
<strong>Outcome</strong>: Prove concept and potential</p>
</div></div><div class="brxe-gicnxg brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><h3 class="brxe-ypkrwz brxe-heading">Phase II: Prototype Development</h3><div class="brxe-bhqonn brxe-text"><p style="text-align: center;">Develop a working prototype and further mature your technology, typically requiring a USSF customer. This can be done either by advancing a successful Phase I project or by applying for a Direct to Phase II (D2P2) award.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>KEY DETAILS</strong>:<br />
<strong>Funding</strong>: $1.25M-$1.8M<br />
<strong>Duration</strong>: Up to 24 months<br />
<strong>Requirement</strong> <strong>(Open Topic Only)</strong>: USSF Customer Memorandum for both Follow-On Phase IIs and D2P2 applicants.<br />
<strong>Direct to Phase II (D2P2)</strong>: This pathway allows qualified small businesses to start with a Phase II. A signed Customer Memorandum is only required for an Open Topic D2P2 as Specific Topics have a pre-identified customer.</p>
</div></div><div class="brxe-gicnxg brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><h3 class="brxe-ypkrwz brxe-heading">STRATFI / TACFI: Growth Stage Investment</h3><div class="brxe-bhqonn brxe-text"><p style="text-align: center;">Bridge the gap between early development and full commercialization. These programs provide significant funding to scale promising technologies.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>KEY DETAILS</strong>:<br />
<strong>Purpose</strong>: Scale technology and achieve transition.<br />
<strong>Eligibility</strong>: For successful Phase II projects (within 2 years).<br />
<strong>Key Feature</strong>: Requires matching funds from government, private investment, or a combination of both sources.<br />
<strong>Strategic Funding Increase (STRATFI)</strong>: $3M-$15M for strategic, high-impact capabilities.<br />
<strong>Tactical Funding Increase (TACFI)</strong>: $375K-$2M for tactical innovation and rapid transition.</p>
</div><a class="brxe-linkkw brxe-button afw-v2-btn bricks-button" href="https://spacewerx.us/accelerate/stratfi-tacfi/" aria-label="Click here to learn more">Learn More</a></div><div class="brxe-gicnxg brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><h3 class="brxe-ypkrwz brxe-heading">Phase III: Commercialization</h3><div class="brxe-bhqonn brxe-text"><p style="text-align: center;">Transition your technology to operational use for the USSF or into the commercial market, funded by non-SBIR/STTR sources.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>KEY DETAILS</strong>:<br />
<strong>Funding</strong>: No direct SBIR/STTR funding.<br />
<strong>Source</strong>: Funded by other government contracts or private investment.<br />
<strong>Benefit</strong>: Completing Phase I/II can lead to sole-source Phase III contracts.</p>
